title: Telangana Cyber Security Bureau arrests two men from Kurnool over movie piracy network
date_note: The page, updated 22 November, gives no earlier day for the arrests.
geo_basis: agency headquarters (TGCSB, Telangana); arrested men are from Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh
summary: Telangana Today reports that the Telangana Cyber Security Bureau (TGCSB) busted a movie piracy network and arrested two men from Kurnool. The network allegedly recorded new films in theatres and distributed them through piracy sites and Telegram channels. Police seized three mobile phones; investigators say they are still trying to identify other members and trace cryptocurrency transactions.
plain: Telangana's cyber police arrested two men from Kurnool for allegedly filming new movies in cinemas and sharing them on piracy sites and Telegram.
exec: Film piracy rings are being targeted by police; TGCSB says piracy can also enable betting and financial fraud.
impact: Two arrests, three phones seized; other members still being traced, per investigators.

validation.note: Telangana Today only, relaying TGCSB statements; no second publisher read.
